# Tools / code-exec / cron / approvals

One line per setting: NAME — default — meaning. Code anchors and full prose:
`docs/CONFIGURATION.md`. Index: `references/configuration.md`.

- AUTONOMOUS_RIG_DEFAULT — default: full — deploy-wide named tool rig for cron/goal runs — `money_rail` | `social` | `research` | `ops` | `full` (the ONE table `core/config_policy/rigs.py::RIGS`, fixed id order so the emitted schemas — part of the cached prompt prefix — are stable).
- AUTONOMOUS_TOOL_DISCLOSURE — default: ON (true) — pin the `<tool-catalog>` block and register `load_tool` for an AUTONOMOUS session independently of `POLYROB_LOCAL`, so a narrow rig can widen itself mid-run.
- STABLE_AUTONOMOUS_TOOLSET — default: ON (true) — freeze the REQUESTED autonomous toolset — stop dropping/re-adding `email` on the 900 s SMTP verdict TTL, which flipped the cached prompt prefix (4 distinct tool counts in one prod day).
- TOOL_SCHEMAS_FROZEN — default: OFF (false) — OPT-IN shape (a) — the provider-neutral schema-freeze bridge.
- ANTHROPIC_DEFERRED_TOOLS — default: ON (true) — shape (b) — Anthropic's NATIVE mid-conversation tool changes, the default late-tool path on a capable Anthropic model.
- AUTONOMOUS_READ_PAGE_LINES — default: 0 (off) — default page (lines) for an UNPAGED `read_file`.

- ANYSITE_API_KEY — default: unset — AnySite API credential.
- CODING_LSP_ENABLED — default: OFF (not safe-local) — After a successful `str_replace`/`apply_patch`/`create_file`, run an external checker (`pyright --outputjson` for `.py`, `tsc --noEmit -p <nearest tsconfig.json>` keeping only this file's errors, or — with no tsconfig — `tsc --noEmit <file…
- CODING_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED — default: OFF (not safe-local) — Shadow-git PER-FILE snapshot/restore.
